title: Cute Pillow
text: Cute Pillow. This pillow arrived slightly compressed. It quickly expanded to its full size. The cat pattern is just on one side. The pillow insert is included. It's a very cute pillow!

product_metadata.title: Mina Victory Pet Beds & Houses Cat Silhouette Black 16" x 16" Throw Pillow
features: Cat silhouette throw pillow with piped edges
Hidden zipper closure located on bottom of pillow
description: Pampered pets will adore their Mina Victory pet beds and pillows. These soft and cuddly accessories are extra cushiony to create a warm and inviting nook for your special dog, cat or other furry friend. Pet owners will appreciate how well made these pet beds and pillows are: durable enough for puppy play, easy to clean. Embrace your pet in dreamy softness for happy naps and restful sleep. Create the perfect plush paradise for every trend-setting pet! Add coziness with a touch of whimsy to your pet bed or couch with this cat throw pillow from Mina Victory Home Accents. The front cover features a repeat pattern of cats wearing brightly colored scarves, which is defined by black piped edges. Handmade from canvas-textured polyester fabric. 16” square; hidden zipper closure. Polyester insert included.
